verdict.rationale: Ramp's marketing documents in-product AI insights and suggestions. These include "Custom reports and insights via AI reporting" on the pricing page, a recommended action on every spend request grounded in policies and budgets, and Ramp Intelligence agents that scan transactions for anomalies, flag fraud and auto-code expenses and memos. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party documentation of how the AI reporting/insights feature works (only one-line marketing mentions), and independent or hands-on corroboration of in-product insight quality.
